newsitem.title: USA: SEC says muni official Golden leaving agency.
newsitem.headline: SEC says muni official Golden leaving agency.

text.p: Securities and Exchange Commission said Friday that Susan Golden will leave the agency on March 2 after two years as deputy director of SEC's office of municipal securities.

"Susan (was) instrumental in establishing the Office of Municipal Securities and making it an effective resource for both the Commission and the municipal finance community. We will all miss her energy and enthusiasm," Paul Maco, director of the office said in a written statement.
Golden, who was an attorney in SEC's enforcement division before joining the muni office, was unavailable for comment.
SEC did not announce if she has accepted another position.
Maco was unavailable for further comment.

Golden also has been acting as the commission's ombudsman to municipal market groups since Mary Jo White, ombudsman and attorney-fellow for munis, left the agency in March to join the Washington lawfirm of Long Aldridge Norman as partner.
SEC said Charlotte Buford, Mark Zehner and Curtis Young continue on as members of its municipal office staff.
